column1: # Upstream path and subject rules for triage.py and translate.py.
# skip     files never ported; a commit made only of them is auto-skipped
#          with reason `value`. translate.py drops them from the patch.
# ios      iOS code: never ported, dropped from the patch. A commit made only
#          of ios (+ skip) files goes to the Android lane, NEVER auto-skip:
#          its iPhone behaviour may belong in apps/android (ADR 0009).
# subject  regex on the commit subject; a match auto-skips with reason `value`
# Patterns: a trailing `/` matches a directory prefix; `*` and `?` are
# fnmatch globs on the whole path; anything else is an exact path.
